content: ## 🤖 How to Create a Telegram Bot — Complete Guide --- ### 📌 Introduction Creating a Telegram bot is easier than you think! By following these simple steps, you will have your own fully functional Telegram bot up and running in just a few minutes. Let's get started! 🚀 --- ## 📋 Steps --- ### ✅ Step 1 — Open Telegram Open the **Telegram** app on your device. --- ### ✅ Step 2 — Open the Search Bar Tap on the **"Search Chats"** option at the top of the screen. --- ### ✅ Step 3 — Find BotFather Type **`BotFather`** in the search bar, then select **`@BotFather`** from the results. > ⚠️ **Important:** Make sure you choose only **`@BotFather`** — the official one with a **verified blue checkmark**. Do **not** select any other similar bots, as they may be fake or harmful. --- ### ✅ Step 4 — Start BotFather Tap the **"Start"** button to begin your conversation with BotFather. --- ### ✅ Step 5 — Send the `/newbot` Command You will see a welcome message from BotFather listing all available commands. Now: 1. Tap the **message field** at the bottom of the screen 2. Type **`/newbot`** 3. Press the **Send** button ➤ This command tells BotFather that you want to create a **new bot**. --- ### ✅ Step 6 — Set a Name for Your Bot BotFather will respond with: > 💬 *"Alright, a new bot. How are we going to call it? Please choose a name for your bot."* > — **@BotFather** Now type a **display name** for your bot. This is the name users will see in chats. **Example names:** - `CocaHotel` - `MyShopBot` - `WeatherAssistant` > 💡 **Tip:** Choose a clear and memorable name that represents your bot's purpose. Then **send** the name. --- ### ✅ Step 7 — Set a Username for Your Bot BotFather will now ask: > 💬 *"Good. Now let's choose a username for your bot. It must end in* `bot`*. Like this, for example:* `TetrisBot` *or* `tetris_bot`*."* > — **@BotFather** Type a **unique username** for your bot, following these rules: | Rule | Example | |------|---------| | Must end with `bot` | `cocahotel_bot` ✅ | | Must be unique (not taken) | `mybot123_bot` ✅ | | Only letters, numbers & underscores | `coca-hotel` ❌ | | No spaces allowed | `coca hotel bot` ❌ | > ⚠️ **Note:** If the username is already taken, BotFather will notify you. Simply try a different one until it is accepted. **Send** your chosen username. --- ## 🎉 Congratulations! Your Bot is Created! Once you submit a valid username, BotFather will send you a **success message** that looks like this: This message contains your **Bot API Token** — a unique key that looks like: ``` 1234567890:AAFxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` --- ## 🔐 Keep Your Token Safe! > 🚨 **CRITICAL WARNING:** > Your **API Token** is like a **password** to your bot. Anyone who has it can **fully control** your bot. > > - ❌ **Never share** it with anyone > - ❌ **Never post** it publicly on GitHub, social media, or forums > - ❌ **Never send** it in chats or emails > - ✅ Store it **securely** in a safe place > - ✅ If leaked, **reset it immediately** using `/revoke` in BotFather --- ## 📝 Quick Summary | Step | Action | |------|--------| | 1 | Open Telegram | | 2 | Search for BotFather | | 3 | Select official **@BotFather** ✔️ | | 4 | Tap **Start** | | 5 | Send **`/newbot`** | | 6 | Set a **display name** | | 7 | Set a unique **username** ending in `bot` | | ✅ | Receive your **API Token** and keep it safe! | --- > 💡 **What's Next?** > Now that you have your bot and API Token, you can start building features using the [Telegram Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api) with Python, JavaScript, or any programming language of your choice! ## Also checkout the guides below that is recommended to you 👇
